subject: [hw] DONE V41 rev 5 (acceptance 651/651; plain-encode auto-share proven on the vendor stack)
body:
Acceptance is now 651/651 (612 per config + 39 real n2vcu), not 646: added a check that the daemon's prependheader=1 reaches venc_vcu_config.prependheader through n2ap_venc_start() for every codec. No product change beyond the HEVC defaults and auto-share already reported.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST V41 PASS 651/651

The plain-encode() auto-share was also proven on the real vendor stack: with IV's runner forced to fds=0, `N2VHOST encode frame fds=0 bytes=115812 key=1` and the 115841-byte stream validated. STATUS.md is current. Still host-only; no phone, no publish.
